scope: React interaction checks for iframe-owned input/select lifecycle, IME and entity selection, recoverable render failures, discussion deep links, footer/navigation actions; mocked geometry and CSS contracts are not browser visual QA

checks.name: forwardRef is the actual iframe textarea and preserves the supplied accessible name
Caller widths and native resize cannot escape the bounded-input contract
Input height controls grow and shrink the textarea without changing its width
Keyboard maximum uses the iframe viewport rather than the larger parent viewport
A smaller visual viewport reclamps an existing input to the keyboard-visible height budget
Keyboard minimum is bounded and exposes matching accessible limits
Reset returns to measured content height and automatic mode
Bounded input preserves ordinary change-event targets and composition callbacks
A horizontal drag does not stretch the field or change its measured height
A long vertical drag clamps to the field's maximum instead of overflowing its height budget
Cancelling a drag removes document pointer listeners
StrictMode/unmount cancels drag, observers, queued measurements and viewport listeners
Iframe input lifecycle never installs size listeners on the parent window
IME confirmation is not hijacked by entity autocomplete while composing
Entity search resumes after composition ends inside the bounded textarea
Selecting a slash result preserves the Markdown link and returns the caret to the iframe textarea
The explicit insert-entry action remains available after textarea replacement
Entity suggestions dismiss using the owning child document
Select flips and offsets using the iframe viewport with mocked geometry
A pointer event in the parent page does not dismiss an iframe selection popup
Scroll targets from the iframe window and DOM do not throw cross-realm Node errors
Iframe resize recomputes popup placement without remounting the field
A visual-viewport scroll recomputes select horizontal bounds and space above the field
The owning document's outside-pointer event closes the custom popup
Custom selection ignores composition Enter and retains the open choice
Keyboard choice skips disabled options and restores focus in the correct document
Unmounting an open select removes child-document, scroll and viewport listeners
A component failure renders actionable recovery controls instead of removing its sibling
A repeated failure remains recoverable while an outside sibling keeps its state
Retry renders recovered content without remounting the outside page state
Changing the route reset key clears a previous rendering fault
Opening #discussion expands the existing discussion panel
An activity-record comment anchor matches the actual comment and receives focus scrolling
A missing comment target falls back to its discussion panel instead of throwing
Account and editor routes do not introduce a second discussion composer
PVE creation is a prominent page-heading action connected to the correct typed editor
Footer removes duplicate account/check-in destinations and preserves useful maintenance and official links
Header and footer use the same player-built encyclopedia declaration
Footer issue feedback triggers the existing contextual feedback action
CSS contract keeps input containers bounded and provides a vertical-only custom grip
CSS contract includes a narrow single-column footer and consistent Georgia wordmark
Only deliberately thrown boundary faults were caught, with no unrelated React/runtime errors
